display_information.name: Vitruvian Slack MCP (Remote)
display_information.description: Read and post in a fixed set of channels, for the network-reachable MCP endpoint. Deliberately narrower than the local app.
display_information.long_description: Backs the HTTP transport of Vitruvian Slack MCP, which is reachable from the public internet and authenticated with OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens. It is a separate Slack app from the local stdio one on purpose, and its bot scopes cover the bot-backed tools that transport exposes. A user token (SLACK_USER_TOKEN) is optional on the HTTP transport: without one, user-scoped tools are withheld and SLACK_CHANNEL_IDS is required; when a user token is configured, user-scoped tools are enabled and the channel allow-list is optional (enforced across reads, writes, search, files and canvases whenever set).
